speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cushing's Syndrome complicated by secondary bacterial bronchitis (Haemophilus influenzae). The elevated cortisol has likely suppressed your immune system, predisposing you to this infection, which explains the productive cough and radiographic findings.
